Parameters (in) ConditionStatus Status of the IUMPR denominator condition (Not-reached, reached, not reachable / inhibited) Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: set of IUMPR denominator condition was successful E_NOT_OK: set of IUMPR denominator condition failed or could not be accepted.
